data.name: Mantle of Moonlight
data.description: Your innate understanding of the moon renders you immune to lycanthropy. Additionally, you may disrupt a lycanthropeUs connection to the moon with a successful touch attack. This action automatically forces the lycanthrope into its humanoid form, which it must remain in for %1 round(s).|OracleMantleofMoonlightDuration
